title: Leome and Partners expertise
description: Practice areas as square hairline cards with a small index, a filled arrow tile and the name. Stacked on phones; from 1024px scattered over three columns beside the heading, drifting at three speeds as you scroll. Entering, a primary panel covering each card shrinks into its top-right corner and the name brightens; on hover the arrow flies out and a copy flies in.
notes: the staggered desktop layout is made for four areas; more follow in rows
motion is CSS scroll-driven; without support the cards sit still and uncovered
